//: For running the app from the IDE against `docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d`, which publishes the dependency ports on loopback.
//secrets: Copy to appsettings.Local.json and fill in. That file is gitignored AND dockerignored — it must never reach the repo or an image. For real credentials prefer `dotnet user-secrets`, which stores outside the repository tree entirely.
//seedAdmin: Only read by `dotnet run --project src/Simando.Web -- seed-admin` (docs/design/03-roles-permissions.md §2.6's bootstrap admin). Never committed with real values; production credentials belong in environment variables (SeedAdmin__Username / SeedAdmin__Password), not this file.
//seedDemo: Only read by `dotnet run --project src/Simando.Web -- seed-demo-users` (README.md § Seeding accounts). Creates one demo/test account per non-SysAdmin role, sharing this one password. Never committed with a real value.
